issue_description: Actual audited expenditure for FY 2024-25 is pending release of CAG Finance Accounts; Revised Estimate reported provisionally.
Difference-in-differences estimate reflects observational association; cannot establish causal attribution due to non-randomized treatment assignment.
Census 2011 district boundaries (174 sq km) differ from expanded Greater Chennai Corporation administrative boundaries (426 sq km); figures normalized to GCC 200 wards.
Cumulative 1-crore screening figure reflects administrative health department portal entries; validated against State Planning Commission independent sample.
Reported road defect resolution reflects administrative maintenance status; ground-level defect recurrence is actively monitored.
Zero synthetic interpolation applied: baseline pre-scheme value recorded as genuine 0 prior to launch on 2023-09-15.
CAG audit finding regarding source segregation shortfall preserved faithfully without turning audit finding into criminal allegation.
